name: c3_take2
prompt: One continuous cinematic architectural take inside this exact bedroom, slow and stabilized. The camera turns away from the lit wood stove, glides through the clear floor space beside the bed and tilts gently upward to the wooden ceiling, revealing the flat black television folded up flat against the ceiling next to the ceiling fan. Once the television is clearly framed it pivots downward on its fixed ceiling mount in one single smooth mechanical movement and comes to rest hanging in its lowered viewing position. The ceiling bracket stays fixed, the television stays rigid and rectangular, keeps exactly the same size and thickness, never detaches, floats or bends, and clears the ceiling fan. Its screen stays dark with soft realistic reflections. The camera settles into a wide view down the room across the grey bedding and white pillows toward the tall black-framed forest windows, the solid round black pod chair standing on the floor by the window, and the deck outside, then holds steady. Level horizon, natural parallax, gentle ease-in and ease-out. The room is exactly as it is and nothing is added: no hanging chair, no swing, no second fireplace, no extra fire anywhere in the room, no new furniture or lamps. Textured wooden ceiling with recessed lights, ceiling fan, dark vertical wall panels, grey stone tiled floor and constant daylight all stay unchanged. No people, no drone, no text.
